verifications_passed: S1: fail-fast fires with job: context — context.failure? == true and context.error is the exact spec message 'No scoring criteria were found in the job description. Regenerate job criteria in Plato AI settings before running reviews.'

S1: fail-fast sits BEFORE any side effects — BulkAiSummaryJobApplication claim-row count unchanged (0 -> 0), zero jobs enqueued (no BulkGenerateAiSummariesJob, no SubmitResumeToTextractJob), and queued_count was never set (short-circuited at line 19 before scope/claim/enqueue). No claim-row poisoning; the missing-fail-fast HIGH is not present.

S2: succeeded-with-criteria latest -> job.zero_criteria_extraction_failure? == false -> fail-fast does NOT fire; interactor proceeded past line 19 (context.success? == true, queued_count set to 0 / skipped_count 3 because the seeded candidates have no resume+textract, which is correct downstream filtering, not the criteria guard).

S3 (critical regression): legacy caller with NO job: key does NOT raise — context.job is nil, `context.job&.zero_criteria_extraction_failure?` safe-navs to nil, guard is skipped, and the interactor runs its full body normally (context.success? == true, skipped_count 3). No NoMethodError-on-nil. Verified even while the job itself was in a failed zero-criteria state (a legacy caller correctly bypasses the check).

Both bulk controller actions reach the fail-fast in production: Api::V1::BulkAiJobApplicationSummariesController#create (line 17) and #all_stages (line 43) both pass job: @job into QueueBulkAiSummaryJobs, so the zero-criteria fail-fast is reachable for both bulk-review entry points.
